message: Your Singpass account will be suspended today. Verify your identity at https://singpass-verify.example.com/login.
source_name: Illustrative example based on an SPF government impersonation advisory
label_rationale: The scenario impersonates Singpass, threatens suspension and directs the recipient to a non-government look-alike domain.
notes: Illustration only; do not place directly into the gold evaluation set.

message: Part-time online job. Earn S$500 per day completing simple product tasks. Pay a S$50 deposit by PayNow to unlock your commission.
source_name: Illustrative example based on an SPF job scam advisory
label_rationale: The message offers implausibly high pay for simple tasks and requires an upfront deposit to receive commission.
notes: Illustration only; do not place directly into the gold evaluation set.

message: Your card purchase of S$18.40 was approved. If this was not you, contact the bank using the number printed on the back of your card.
label_rationale: This controlled legitimate-style template avoids links and directs the recipient to an independently available official contact channel.
notes: A hard negative designed to test overreaction to security-alert language.

message: Hi, are you free to talk? I need your help with something urgent.
label_rationale: Urgency is present, but the message contains no request or provenance sufficient to determine whether it is fraudulent.
notes: Used to test abstention rather than forced classification.
